b5zm184f.baseName: Walplus 150 LEDs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
b5zm184f.variantName: Walplus 150 LEDs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
b5zm184f.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 95 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Number of PVC tips: 340 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

kdjxh9e8.baseName: Neo 50cm Frosted Pine Cone Decorative Wreath
kdjxh9e8.variantName: Neo 50cm Frosted Pine Cone Decorative Wreath
kdjxh9e8.sourceDescription: Add a welcoming seasonal touch to your home with this decorative wreath, designed with a full arrangement of artificial foliage and decorative details to create an attractive display. The layered design provides plenty of texture and depth, making it an eye-catching addition to your seasonal decorations. Ideal for displaying on front doors, internal doors, walls, porches, hallways or above fireplaces and mantelpieces, the wreath can be easily incorporated into a variety of home settings. Its artificial construction means no watering or ongoing maintenance is required, and it can be carefully stored away after use ready for future seasonal displays. Suitable for decorative use, the wreath provides a simple way to update your home throughout the season and can be displayed on its own or coordinated with other seasonal decorations. Measuring approximately 50cm in diameter (50cmx50cmx50cm) WARNING: For decorative use only. This product is not a toy. Keep out of reach of young children and pets, as small decorative components may become detached and present a choking hazard. Keep away from open flames, candles and other direct heat sources. Do not place near sources of ignition. Check the wreath regularly for loose or damaged components and discontinue use if damaged. Ensure the wreath is securely mounted when displayed to prevent it from falling. Packaging materials should be kept away from children and disposed of after unpacking. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom
